LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we form words from other words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words
2. use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences
3. appreciate the value of adverbs in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the value of adverbs in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we form words from other words?
2. What are the functions of adverbs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words
2. use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences
3. appreciate the value of adverbs in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
